identity.name: Knee Surgery & Related Research

identity.source_note: Live SpringerLink guide (https://link.springer.com/journal/43019/submission-guidelines) is bot-blocked — headless Apify render returned an Akamai 'Client Challenge' page. The journal's BMC platform (kneesurgrelatres.biomedcentral.com) has migrated (301) to SpringerLink. Encoded from Wayback archive snapshots of the unchanged BMC guide: general/figures/tables from https://web.archive.org/web/20250526150307/https://kneesurgrelatres.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript and journal-specific rules from https://web.archive.org/web/20250614070052/https://kneesurgrelatres.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/research-article (both ~13 months old, marginally over the 12-month bound; content is the current unchanged BMC editorial guide, only the hosting platform changed).

encoding_notes: PUBLISHER/PLATFORM MIGRATION: KSRR is a BioMed Central (Springer Nature) open-access journal for the Korean Knee Society; its BMC site (kneesurgrelatres.biomedcentral.com) now 301-redirects to SpringerLink (link.springer.com/journal/43019). The live SpringerLink guide is Akamai bot-blocked (headless render returned a 'Client Challenge'); encoded from ~13-month-old Wayback snapshots of the BMC guide (2025-05-26 general page, 2025-06-14 research-article page) whose content is the current, unchanged editorial guide.
jksrr.org (Korean Knee Society legacy mirror, content frozen ~2019, pre-BMC) was NOT used as a source — it predates the current BMC editorial model.

double_blind=true quoted: 'As this journal operates a double-blind peer review system, please do not include identifying information in your main manuscript... please include these in your Title Page, along with the author names and contact information.' scrub_metadata=true set consistent with double-blind (document-properties scrub not separately spelled out).

Title page: guide also directs that identifying declaration sections (Authors' contributions, Competing interests) be moved to the title page for blinding — not added to elements array since conditional.
Abstract has a conditional 5th subsection 'Trial registration' (RCTs/health-care-intervention studies) beyond the four core sections encoded; RCT abstracts follow the CONSORT extension.

references.style='custom' = Springer 'Basic' reference style, e.g. 'Smith J, Jones M Jr, Houghton L (1999) Future of health insurance. N Engl J Med 965:325-329.' (author + (year) + NLM journal abbrev + vol:pages; DOI appended when available). in_text='bracket' and order='cited' are derived from the named Springer Basic style (numbered, square-bracket, citation-order) — the guide pages read did NOT explicitly state the in-text marker. journal_abbrev='nlm' quoted: 'Journal abbreviations follow Index Medicus/MEDLINE.'
No manuscript word-count cap is stated (BMC does not cap main text); only abstract is capped at 350 words. references_min/max, figures_max, tables_max all unstated => null.

article_types: original_research + review are confirmed by current BMC article-type formatting sub-pages. case_report, technical_note, editorial, letter reflect the journal's documented standing scope ('original articles, review articles, editorials, technical notes, case reports, and letters to the editor') but have no dedicated BMC formatting sub-page; sections/word_limits are encoded only for original_research (the one type with an explicit prescribed order).

Layout: 'Use double line spacing', 'Include line and page numbering', 'Do not use page breaks'. line_numbers='continuous' (BMC standard; guide says 'line numbering' without the word 'continuous'). Font, size, margins, alignment, indent, page-size all unstated => null (tables reference both 'A4 or Letter', so no single prescribed page size).

Figures: separate uploaded files, numbered in citation order, multi-panel as single composite file, <=10MB each; min_dpi 300 quoted 'image resolution of approximately 300 dpi ... at the final size'; figure title max 15 words, legend max 300 words 'provided in the main manuscript' => legends_location='figure_legends_section' (ambiguous between an inline vs a collected legends section; guide only says 'in the main manuscript'). Allowed BMC formats also include MS Word, PowerPoint, BMP, CDX which have no schema slot and were omitted.

Tables: <1 A4/Letter page placed in-text 'in the appropriate location within the manuscript', >1 page 'at the end of the document text file' => placement='in_text' with an end-of-document exception; title above / legend below the table; Arabic numerals.
orcid_required and cover_letter_required set to conservative false (not stated on the guide pages read). highlights not used by this journal => highlights_required=null.
ISSN 2234-2451 is the eISSN printed on the guide footer; the print ISSN (2234-0726) was not present on the pages read.

CONFIDENCE medium: values are from a verifiable but ~13-month-old archive of the BMC guide (just over the 12-month bound) because the live SpringerLink page is bot-blocked; house-style values are cross-publisher-stable and journal-specific values reflect the unchanged BMC editorial guide.
